text:
cheng: Quick heads-up — we started seeing a p50 latency regression on qwen2.5-xlarge after yesterday's kernel swap. batch=8, seq=8192, quant=4bit. Looks like attention copy / KV reshape time jumped.

olivia: Which kernel swap exactly? matmul or attention loop? any perf profile available? :eyes:

cheng: matmul/fused-attn v3.2 -> v3.3 (switched to fused fp16 path). I attached a short flame snippet from perf profiler:
```
PROFILE SNAPSHOT (sampled)
-- timeline --
12.1%  attention_copy
18.6%  kv_reshape
24.9%  matmul_fp16_fused
08.2%  sequence_padding
10.3%  tokenizer_dedupe
26.0%  other
```
Not huge, but p50 moved ~10-15% and p95 ~8% worse under multi-ling loads.

raj: Noted. We also saw tokenizer producing longer token counts for zh/jp when mixed with en — leads to more KV rows per request. Could be pushing caching thresholds and causing extra memory copies.

emma: Could this be a RoPE scaling mismatch with the new kernels? We saw subtle head/kv dim misalign earlier when we used dynamic rope scaling for Qwen family.

mike: I ran a small AB with rope_scale=1.0 vs rope_scale=0.8 and saw better p50 with 0.8 on long context but slightly worse generation quality on certain prompts. Worth testing fallback to ALiBi for those sequences.

olivia: Is there an easy repro? If we can isolate attention_copy vs kv_reshape we can try reverting matmul only.

cheng: Repro script (quick):
```
python perf_run.py --model qwen2.5-xlarge --quant 4 --batch 8 --seq 8192 --prompts perf_mixed_lang.json --profile
```
prompts file mixes zh/en/jp to trigger tokenizer edge cases.

deploy-bot: perf-run job started (id perf-177300). logs: https://ci.internal/perf-177300

raj: Also check head vs kv-head config. I found a case where attention heads=64 but kv_heads reported 32 due to an exporter mismatch; that caused extra reshape ops on every decode step.

emma: Good catch. If kv_heads != heads we do an extra projection reshape that is O(seq * hidden) each step. That explains kv_reshape costs.

mike: For quick mitigation: add a runtime guard to skip fused fp16 matmul for qwen2.5-xlarge when seq>4096 or when tokenizer is mixed-lang — cheaper fallback but avoids the hotspot.

cheng: Plan: 1) reproduce with script + profiling (mike), 2) validate head/kv alignment in model metadata (raj), 3) try rope_scale/ALiBi variants A/B (emma), 4) short rollback of matmul fuse as emergency if p50 stays bad (olivia). I'll open a tiny RFC and a perf ticket.

olivia: Assign to @mike for repro, @raj for model metadata, @emma for rope/alibi AB. I'll stand by to coordinate rollback.

mike: Starting repro now, will post flame graphs when done. :rocket:

cheng: Thanks — high priority for Dedicated customers hitting >8k contexts. ping me in thread with results. :thumbsup:
